concerns.text: T022 (Calculate Teacher advantage gap) is marked as depending on T022a (Baseline Estimator), but T022a is listed AFTER T022 in the task sequence. The producer (T022a) must precede the consumer (T022) to satisfy data-flow dependencies.

T022a (Baseline Estimator) is listed after T022 (Advantage Gap Calculation) in the implementation list, violating the 'Producer before Consumer' rule. T022a generates V_baseline(s) which T022 consumes; T022a must be ordered before T022.

T024 (Dynamic weighting logic) and T021 (Uniform distillation) are listed after T022/T023 (Advantage gap logic), but T021 (Uniform) does not depend on the advantage gap logic. While not a hard block, T021 should logically precede or be parallel to T022/T023 to allow independent implementation of the baseline regime.

Phase 7 tasks (T063-T069) are safety assertions and logging enhancements for existing modules (env, agents, training, analysis). They are marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depend on the core implementation of those modules (T012, T014, T022, T032, etc.) being complete. The 'Dependencies & Execution Order' section states Phase 7 'Must be integrated into all previous phases before final execution', but the task list places them as a separate Phase 7 block. If T063 depends on T012, T063 cannot be parallel with T012; it must follow it. The [P] tag is misleading if these tasks are strictly sequential to their target modules.

T028 (Epsilon-guarded division) is listed before T022 (Advantage gap calculation) which it protects. While T028 is a utility/safety fix, it logically belongs within or immediately after the implementation of the logic it protects (T022/T023) to ensure the 'Producer' (the logic) is ready for the 'Consumer' (the safety check) to be integrated. Currently, T028 is listed as a standalone task before the logic it secures.
